doubles a response that is already the largest Lab sends.

Logistic regression on the residual stream after `layer`, at each
prompt's last token - the same reading a steering vector is made from.
Each set needs a few prompts, so that some can be held out to measure
the probe on prompts it was not trained on.

A difference of means between two sets of prompts at one layer.

Contrastive activation addition: the mean residual stream after
`layer`, at each prompt's last token, over the positive prompts minus
the same over the negative ones. Added back in, it pushes the model
towards whatever separates the two sets.

post.description: The full vector at one site, layer and position of a prompt. A POST rather than a GET so the prompt travels in the body, not in a URL that proxies and logs keep.

Generates greedily from the prompt twice, first as the model is and then with the interventions applied at every step, and streams both answers token by token as server-sent events. A request that cannot run is refused before the stream opens; one that fails once it has started ends the stream with an `error` event.

post.summary: Generate with and without edits to the forward pass

post.description: Runs the prompt through the resident model once and returns, for every layer and position, the residual stream's norm, the logit lens's likeliest tokens, and the MLP neurons with the largest activations, and the strongest SAE features at layers this deployment has SAEs for. Summaries, not raw activations: read one whole vector with the activation route.
post.summary: Read the logit lens, top MLP neurons and SAE features for a prompt

put.description: Starts fetching and loading the named model, and answers once that has started. The switch replaces the model for every user of this Lab; poll the status to see it finish. Naming the model already resident, or already being switched to, changes nothing.

The answer says how accurate it was on prompts held out of training, beside chance. Lab holds it for the person who trained it until the model changes; apply it when scoring.

post.description: Either generates a greedy answer to the prompt and scores it, or scores the prompt itself as plain text, without the chat template. Entropy is over the whole vocabulary. The first token of a text is not scored: nothing came before it. Optionally, each scored token's distance from ordinary text at a layer, and what one of your probes makes of it.

get.description:
Ready to answer, whether or not a model is resident yet.

Gating this on the model looks right and is a trap: an unready pod
is taken out of its Service, so after a failed load nobody could
reach Lab to choose a model that works. Whether runs can be made is
the status route's `ready`, which the web app reads.
